_schema.purpose: Failures that are already understood and tracked. A failing test that matches an entry does not turn the nightly run verdict red. See docs/strategy/Test-Report-Dashboard-and-Triage-Plan.md §4.1.
_schema.jira: Jira key that tracks the fix (e.g. ABP-12345). Required for PRODUCT_DEFECT entries.
_schema.title: One line: what is wrong.
_schema.match: All given selectors must match. spec: glob relative to tests/ (** spans folders, * stays in one folder). test: case-insensitive substring of the test title. testRegex: case-insensitive regex on the test title, for titles that are a substring of another (e.g. ^Process - vs Sub-process -). messageRegex: regex on the error message (all lines; the first line is shown in reports). environment / gateway: optional lists (QA, INTEROP / AZURE, GRAVITEE); omit to match all.
_schema.owner: Team or person who follows up.
_schema.expires: Date to re-check, YYYY-MM-DD (max ~3 months). Expired entries stop applying and are listed in the verdict.
_schema.autoCloseAfterPasses: Consecutive passing runs before suggesting the issue may be fixed; defaults to 3.
_schema.candidates: npm run triage:suggest -- --results <allure-results> lists recurring failures to register.
